# SOP-P1-L1-01 Line startup - Hot Forge line
Revision: Rev B
Plant: P1, line P1-L1
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03
Related: MM-P1-L1-IH03, SB-1009, SOP-P1-L1-03

Preconditions
1. All preventive maintenance for EQ-P1-L1-IH03 completed per MM-P1-L1-IH03.
2. Safety bulletin SB-1009 reviewed and applicable controls in place.
3. Communication with downstream cell per SOP-P1-L1-03 confirmed.

Required PPE
1. Flame-resistant coveralls.
2. Welder's gloves and impact-resistant sleeves.
3. Face shield plus safety goggles.
4. Hearing protection and steel-toe boots.
5. Heat-resistant gloves for billet handling.

Procedure
1. Visual inspection
   1.1. Verify no foreign material in the furnace area of EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and approach paths to EQ-P1-L1-RR01 and EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
   1.2. Confirm guards and interlocks are engaged.

2. Induction heater preparation (EQ-P1-L1-IH03)
   2.1. Load billet following handling protocol.
   2.2. Set control recipe to target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C.
   2.3. Monitor temperature rise; verify alarm thresholds per MM-P1-L1-IH03.

3. Conveyor and ring rolling mill readiness (EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-RR01)
   3.1. Verify conveyor drive and alignment visually.
   3.2. Check mandrel clamp and tooling secure.
   3.3. Confirm the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 635 N·m.

4. Functional checks
   4.1. Execute control interlock test sequence.
   4.2. Run a cold pass without billet to confirm motion profiles and emergency stop response.
   4.3. Initiate a monitored heat cycle and perform a first-piece inspection per SOP-P1-L1-03.

5. Startup handover
   5.1. Transfer control to production operator only after all checks pass.
   5.2. Record all readings and anomalies in line log.

Sign-off
Operator signature: ______________________
Printed name: ______________________
Supervisor signature: ______________________
Comments/Nonconformances: ______________________
